tests.note: Self-test is disabled because some sites (e.g. planet.fr) navigate away after clicking the disagree button, which destroys the Didomi state.

Didomi with the Gimii 'Cookies for good' prompt, which opens once Didomi consent is refused; the rule then refuses it too. FR only: in the US senscritique.com hides Didomi from automated browsers and largus.fr shows no popup.

US-specific Didomi sites where the CMP runs in CCPA/CPRA mode. In CCPA mode there is no explicit reject button, so the rule relies on the Didomi JS API (EVAL_DIDOMI_OPT_OUT) instead of clicking a DOM element.
Publisher wrapper (#acceptationCMPWall) that only unlocks the page on Didomi UI click events, so the rule rejects via the preferences screen instead of the JS API.
"Consent or pay" notices where the disagree button is a paid or subscription option: the rule must leave them to the user.
